messages:
alex: Quick security check for staging debug logs on Dedicated — need a rapid consensus. Proposed minimal capture for failed LLM requests:

```
{\n  hashed_user_id: string (sha256 with per-customer salt),
  model: string,
  truncated_response_length: int,
  latency_ms: int,
  trace_id: string,
  prompt_fingerprint: string (sha256),
  error_code: string
}
```

Exclude: prompt_text, raw_response, auth headers/tokens, embedding vectors. I was thinking to allow storing the first 32 chars of system prompt only behind an opt-in flag for regression triage, but I'm worried about PII. Thoughts? @maria @jess

maria: +1 on excluding prompt_text and raw_response. For hashed_user_id we need a per-customer salt. Do NOT log emails or identifiers un-hashed. :thumbsup:

sam: I'd avoid storing any prefix of system prompt. Prompts can contain PII. Instead store prompt_fingerprint + length. That still lets us dedupe without exposing content.

ops-bot: Automated: created debug-capture request ISSUE-789 and linked it to this thread: https://rwd/internal/issue/ISSUE-789

jess: ++ Sam. Also require that any temporary captures have an allowlist and explicit SRE approval, with audit entries. Trace_id mappings must be ephemeral and only resolvable by the deploy owner.

dev: If we pseudonymize user ids, will that break our grouping in Sentry/ops? We group by user for some bug triage flows.

maria: Use a stable pseudonymized id (sha256(user_id + customer_salt)) so grouping still works across runs but is irreversible without salt. Salt is per-customer and stored in KMS.

infra: Implementation note: plan to add REDWOOD_LOG_MASK_LEVEL env and a flag for prompt_fingerprint. Can we get sign-off to roll to staging for 48h? Will keep raw payload capture disabled by default.

alex: Requesting quick sign-off from @jess and @maria to ship to staging for 48h with: no raw prompts/resp, pseudonymized ids, prompt_fingerprint only, embedding vectors never logged, audit trail enabled. If approved I'll open the PR and attach the audit request.

jess: Approved for staging 48h under these constraints: no raw prompt/response, stable pseudonymized ids, prompt fingerprint only, audit trail, notify customer-data team. :white_check_mark:

maria: Approved. Please add a changelog entry and automatic deletion of captured snippets after 7 days (default TTL).

audit-bot: Policy note: temporary debug captures require an /audit-request with justification. Found request: AR-2026-4123 linked to ISSUE-789.

alex: Thanks — I'll open the PR, include AR-2026-4123, and ping this thread when deployed to staging.

sam: One more item: embeddings MUST NOT be logged. Log only vector dimensions/size if needed.

alex: Noted. Will add explicit check in the logging middleware to drop any field named `embedding` or `vectors`.

jess: Also add an alert on accidental raw-payload capture (file a policy rule). If trigger fires, auto-revoke staging creds and notify SRE/security.

alex: Good call. I'll add that to the PR checklist.
